name: 7fe89fda8b0c
claim: A portal rebuild started without its token env auto-generates a new inbound control-plane token and silently returns 401 to every peer holding the previously shared token; re-pin the shared contract token via the process env at restart, and keep one shared token in both directions with out-of-band rotation.

decisions.notes: The rebuilt portal auto-generated a 38-char token; the shared 43-char token returned 401 until the portal was restarted with the shared token as ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN; the prior working token kept validating via the PT persisted-token lane.

rationale: Inbound validation and outbound bearer must use the same shared value on both hosts; a portal validating a token no peer holds is broken by definition.
